I replied to Tobias in a thread on their #central-random message: the ticket is **PD-4821**.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on 2026-06-09 and said the Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply is attached to that ticket. I also passed on Hollis's warning from that thread. The import file labels the doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. That needs sorting out before anyone reimports, or it will create duplicate entries.

Tobias is a member of #central-team, so this is something they could see themselves. Ticket numbers are operational facts, so sharing it in the channel was fine.
